description: A collection of fields describing the current or historical custody of an object or resource.

Custodian.description: Identifies the person or organisation responsible for the custody of an object or resource.

Relationship.description: Describes the relationship between two entities, persons, or resources.

Type.description: Describes the type of custodial status associated with an object or resource.

Date.description: Records the date associated with a change or period of custody of an object or resource.
